decisions.reason: The address autocomplete service runs on the firm's long-built databases and fits its SaaS and web-service platform direction, so it costs little to keep and visibly carries the announced strategy.
The Austrian gas grid fee database is a visible expansion of the core grid fee data business, and weak uptake can still be blamed on a slow ramp-up in a foreign market, so management persists.
Peak load window determination belongs to the firm's core regulated network operator processes and embodies invested analytical know-how, so it stays.
The end-customer tariff database is a multi-model product line with heavy data investment and strong public commitment, which makes dropping it very unlikely.
Custom web services extend the platform and end-to-end service model the firm has announced, and serving them has low marginal cost.
The postal code lookup service reuses the established address and grid-area data, fits the web-service portfolio, and is cheap to maintain.
